note: One authoritative statement per high-stakes clinical fact, and the pages that must agree with it. Seeded 2026-09-03 with 30 slots chosen for being high-consequence AND asserted in more than one place. Every slot is 'pending': the canonical statement is a faculty assertion and was deliberately left unwritten. Filling one means writing the statement, listing appliesTo pages, and setting status to 'reviewed'. Validated by bin/validate_canonical_claims.py against canonical_claims.schema.json.
